visualCharacteristics: New variant (no existing variants in project): Compact text-led promo slider with circular Prev/Next arrows, no full-bleed imagery | Light blue band (.cmp-fund-finder, #dbedff). Left: white panel with fund search (text input, 2 selects, 'View N results' button, 'View all funds' link). Right: text-only slider with Prev/Next circle arrows (4 slides: MyJupiter, FAQ, Wake up to UK equities, Funds in the spotlight; tab labels hidden). The two blocks sit side by side on desktop and stack on mobile.

contentPattern.reason: Interactive slider with Prev/Next controls and 4 slides; keep all 4 slides, including the one with an image.

usage: Compact text-led promo slider with Prev/Next circular arrow buttons. One row per slide: optional image | heading, paragraph, CTA link. Empty image cells are dropped.
reuseGuidance: Use for short promo/announcement rotations beside other content. Not for full-bleed hero imagery (use carousel-hero).
